## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The `--exclude` flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI jobs can omit files through their standard environment configuration.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches filenames, logs skipped paths at INFO level, and omits those files from the archive. It also documents the flag and adds parser and archive tests.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the `--exclude` default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — Running `archive src` with `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` still archives `debug.log` because the parser hardcodes `default=[]`. The CLI policy says new flags “must also take [their] default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test an exact filename exclusion in a subdirectory — If the matcher receives the full path, `--exclude debug.log` leaves `nested/debug.log` in the archive and the tests still pass. Every tested pattern starts with `*`, which also matches a directory prefix. — The tests would miss a regression that breaks exact filename exclusions for nested files. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` with a nested file and an exact filename pattern.
